text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Seiun Sky...
We ran into that white cat from before once again.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
Are you heading out too, Shiro?

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Meow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? Trainer-san,
this is an invitation for a walk!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan's tagged along plenty of times before♪
Well, since we're here, let's go, let's go!"

And so, I ended up tagging along
on Shiro's walk, but...

...Unexpectedly, walking a cat apparently
involved covering quite a long distance.
choice_data_list: We sure are walking a lot……
We sure are walking a lot, huh……

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just patrolling the territory! You know, this is actually very important work for a cat, you see?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I learned all kinds of things after taking Shiro for walks, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: When I was a child, I had a simple fondness for cats too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whenever I went fishing with Grandpa, they'd just be basking in the sun nearby, looking so cozy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Living a carefree, lazy life.
I thought that's what being a cat was all about.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it goes to show
the cat world is tough too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
First, we need a territory. A feeding ground, a water source,
and a warm place to sleep are all absolute musts.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the other kids fight over it, too.
I've got to patrol and protect it every single day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, you've gotta be strong and smart to survive as a stray. Right, Shiro?"

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, Shiro was my teacher,
who taught me things like that during our walks.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, the name Shiro comes from the Grandmaster, not the color white.
He's truly a blessed little guy~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, what I said about the name was a lie, though.

And just as my territory patrol with Shiro
was drawing to an end—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. This might be a little bad...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...It's a turf war.
Look, another cat is coming from over there.

The three cats walked straight up to Shiro,
bristling their fur and hissing aggressively.

text_block_list.name: Three Cats
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, up against three of them, huh...

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Hisss!!!
Shiro's menacing growl sent two of the three animals scurrying away with their tails between their legs!
choice_data_list: You've got quite an impressive presence!
You've got quite an impressive presence!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Though in the past, he was so tough that other cats would run away before a fight even started.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And yet, someone's aiming for our territory now...
Besides, look. That one over there is still raring to go.

text_block_list.name: Young Cat
text_block_list.text: SHAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: ...! Phew~!

And so, after several minutes of glaring at each other...
Shiro turned its back on its opponent and ran off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Shiro, you lost, huh.
choice_data_list: There's always someone better out there...
There's always someone better out there, huh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Shiro, you lost, huh.
choice_data_list: There's always someone better out there...
There's always someone better out there, huh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Shiro has gotten weaker.
Well, he's quite old now after all...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong a cat is, it gets old
and eventually falls to the younger ones... Everything is fleeting, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I feel like I deserve some kind of reward
for working so hard to get by all this time, though..."

Staring in the direction Shiro had left,
Seiun Sky muttered lonely words as if to herself...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...It ended with just a stare-down. Nobody got hurt, so it's all fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it's only a matter of time, I suppose.
Shiro is getting old too, so I really should..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's nothing.
It's gotten dark, so shall we head back soon?

She seemed to have something on her mind,
but we decided to just head home for today...
